answer: Copying the same citations across 45 aliases thus pays the reading cost 45 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the echo check immediately, the basalt audit keeps the resolved set and the garden replay makes public exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
